evidence.reason: The CLI boundary catches only UsageRefusal and ValueError/RuntimeError/OSError. A KeyboardInterrupt from boot cleanup therefore propagates in --json mode, so stdout gets no JSON artifact and stderr may receive a traceback, violating the I1 machine-mode output contract. Catching KeyboardInterrupt at this boundary after cleanup and emitting the existing thrown error artifact (exit 1) is the minimal repair; it does not require owner judgment.
